name: Service process - list
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Service process - list.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Layout
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for layout. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Show numbers
settings.how: Turn on “Show numbers” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Current step index (1-based, 0 = not set)
settings.info: Display-only process progress. This does not track customer orders or workflow completion.
settings.how: Enter a number for current step index (1-based, 0 = not set). Follow the unit and instructions shown below. A number alone does not create a Shopify discount, shipping rate, or inventory rule.
